description: Persist a single platform-level config entry to profile/config/platform.json and apply it in-process when the platform knows how to. Distinct from reload_plugin_config: that verb covers per-plugin JSON; this verb covers platform-wide settings that live outside any plugin — log level, default model selection, env-var-like knobs. The (scope, key) pair is validated against an allowlist constant at the top of the service: only pairs explicitly registered there can be written, so adding a new entry requires both an allowlist edit and a code path that consumes it. The v1 allowlist contains a single entry: ('logging', 'log_level'); writing it applies the new level to the root logger via logging.getLogger().setLevel and the response carries restart_required=false. Future allowlist entries that have no in-process applier are persisted with restart_required=true so the caller knows to reboot. The value is stored verbatim; type and range validation are the caller's responsibility. Returns prev_value=null when no prior entry existed at scope.key.
embedding_description: Update a platform-level config entry — persisted to profile/config/platform.json + applied in-process when an applier exists. Distinct from reload_plugin_config (per-plugin). (scope, key) is allowlisted; v1 allows ('logging', 'log_level') with in-process applier. Future allowlist entries with no in-process applier return restart_required=true. Returns prev_value (null if new entry).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Update result with keys: applied (bool, true on a successful write), prev_value (any, the previous value at scope.key or null), restart_required (bool, true when only the persisted change took effect), scope (str), key (str), message (str status detail).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the scope.key written, name the new value and the previous value (or 'no prior entry' when prev_value is null), and surface restart_required explicitly. If restart_required is true, say so and recommend the restart; if false, say the change is live immediately.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: After a successful immediate-apply (restart_required=false), the next downstream action reflects the new setting; for log_level specifically, subsequent log lines will respect the new threshold. If restart_required is true, do not assume the new value is active in this session — only the persisted file has changed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Persist a single platform-level (scope, key) config entry and apply it in-process when possible
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: scope or key was empty. NotAllowlistedError: the (scope, key) pair is not in the platform-config allowlist; only entries explicitly registered can be written. ConfigManagerUnavailable: the orchestrator's config manager attribute is missing. ConfigWriteFailure: writing profile/config/platform.json failed (permission, disk full). ImmediateApplyFailure: an applier raised when projecting the new value into the running process (e.g., logging.log_level rejected a malformed string) — the persisted file has been updated but the in-process state has not.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For NotAllowlistedError: the platform does not accept arbitrary platform config writes from process calls; extend the allowlist in code and pair it with an applier before retrying. For ConfigWriteFailure: check disk permissions and free space, then retry. For ImmediateApplyFailure: correct the value type and retry; the persisted file is still readable on the next restart.
